title: lucid-team.yaml
description: Version 1 of the Lucidbench AI-team spec: which provider fills each role of the loop, and which gates stay with a human. See docs/TEAM-SPEC.md.

roles.description: A missing role means Lucidbench's default for it.

critic.description: One role, or a list of up to two. The council runs them in parallel.

gates.description: Version 1 keeps every gate with a human; a missing gate is human.

profile.description: A host account profile of the provider; omitted or "default" is the default profile. Grok has none.

model.description: The provider CLI's model name or alias, for example sonnet, haiku, gpt-5-codex or grok-4.

mcp_allow.description: MCP server names the role may use, as they appear on the MCP servers page.

allowed_commands.description: Builder only: the shell commands a Work session may run without asking (command prefixes). git push, git remote, rm, shells, curl, wget and gh are always refused.

budget_usd.description: What one run of the role should cost at most, in US dollars. Version 1 warns; it never stops a run.
